Use case: stylized-concept.
Create the CARDINAL sheet of an eight-view 360-degree turnaround for HAVENLINE CHARACTER 2. Input image1 is the user's authoritative NEW STYLE, body proportion, material and studio lighting reference. Input image2 is the approved existing CHARACTER 2 IDENTITY, clothing and equipment reference. Apply the polished mature stylized 3D appearance of image1 to the distinct person in image2. Keep adult stylized proportions around 5.4 head heights with normal torso, full-length legs and actual fingers. Do NOT copy image1's man's face, beard, short hair, no-pack configuration or exact outfit onto this woman. Do NOT retain image2's oversized chibi head, toy proportions or navy board. Match image1's smooth polished skin, detailed cloth seams, dense cream shearling, dimensional leather and boots, with soft neutral studio light.

This is CHARACTER 2: the warm medium-skinned adult woman from input image2, brown eyes, straight dark chin-length bob with a broad side-swept fringe, brown rectangular glasses, clean face with NO beard. Preserve her blue hood worn UP around the hair with thick cream shearling edging, gray neck scarf, closed blue coat with orange shoulder accents and orange front/hem piping, cream wrist cuffs, charcoal FULL FINGERED gloves, navy cargo trousers with knee pads, cream lower-leg cuffs, and brown lace-up capped boots. Keep the brown belt with silver buckle and brown chest/shoulder harness. One brown backpack, one light-BLUE horizontal cylindrical bedroll across its top, original pale side attachments and stitched brown pouches. The brown utility pouch is fixed on her anatomical RIGHT hip; the single silver cup is on her anatomical LEFT side. Front view: pouch is viewer-left and cup viewer-right; rear view: these sides reverse naturally. No extra bags or rolls.
Composition: high-resolution square 2048x2048 studio reference sheet, clean TWO-COLUMN by TWO-ROW layout, exactly FOUR full-body figures of the SAME character at the same scale and height, on the same light neutral gray seamless studio surface. Match the soft lighting/contact shadows and polished 3D materials in input image1. No navy board, snow, heavy frames or decorative scene. Give each figure generous empty padding around hands, fingertips, boots and head; no cropping. Small charcoal title at top exactly "HAVENLINE | CHARACTER 2", subtitle "CARDINAL VIEWS". Minimal dark-gray captions.
Top-left: exact FRONT at 0 degrees, caption "FRONT · 0°".
Top-right: exact anatomical LEFT profile at 90 degrees, face/nose pointing to image LEFT, caption "LEFT · 90°".
Bottom-left: exact BACK at 180 degrees, facing completely away with face invisible, caption "BACK · 180°".
Bottom-right: exact anatomical RIGHT profile at 270 degrees, face/nose pointing to image RIGHT, caption "RIGHT · 270°".

Rotate the same WHOLE person and equipment through these four orientations. Keep every figure in neutral level T-POSE: arms straight out sideways at shoulder height, PALMS DOWN, fingers naturally extended, feet parallel at hip width and boots flat. Head stays aligned with torso and turns with it, not looking separately toward camera. In the exact side profiles the lateral arms naturally point toward/away from camera and foreshorten; do not lower the arms or fake both spread sideways in profile. Hands are anatomically coherent with FOUR fingers and ONE thumb each, no extra/missing/fused digits, no mitten shapes, no detached fingers. Normal profile occlusion is allowed. Front and back are distinct views, with no face, front zipper or frontal garment opening repeated on the back. Equipment remains attached to its same anatomical side; do not mirror-swap it. Preserve identity, hair structure, coat opening/closure, pocket count, material colors, pack/bedroll type, and boots across all panels. Static modeling reference only; no action poses or rig/animation claims.
